target_customer: TypeScript developers and companies that want auth on their own database, with paid enterprise and infrastructure add-ons
problem: Developers had to choose between hosted auth services with lock-in and cost, or older libraries with gaps, instead of a comprehensive framework they own.
business_model: Open source framework with paid infrastructure layer and enterprise features (dashboard, audit logs, security detection)

founders.name: Bereket Engida
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch calls him self-taught and from Ethiopia. Previously built open source TypeScript libraries Better Call, Better Fetch and Loglib per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A comprehensive auth framework with plugins across databases and frameworks is standard but wide engineering, built largely by one founder plus contributors.

defensibility.rationale: Embedded auth on a customer's own database creates switching costs and a large open source community (about 1000 contributors per company site), though code is MIT licensed and forkable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Auth.js joined Better Auth in September 2025, and Vercel acquired Better Auth in July 2026.

market_need_then: Developers wanted ownership of auth data and lower cost than hosted services. TechCrunch reported 150,000 weekly downloads and 15,000 GitHub stars by June 2025.

branding.name_origin: Founder says he came up with the name better-auth and decided to build it if the npm package name was free, and it was.

identity.voice_and_tone: Community framed, 'we can do better as a community'

branding.brand_signature: The npm package name better-auth and the community of 1000+ contributors
branding.community_and_virality: TechCrunch reported over 6,000 Discord members, 15,000 GitHub stars in June 2025, and the site now claims 31k stars and 20M weekly downloads. Auth.js maintainers joined in 2025.

brand_strength.rationale: Became a default recommendation for TypeScript auth with heavy press coverage and community growth, helped by a plain descriptive name tied to the package.

outcome_analysis: Better Auth grew through open source distribution, raised a 5 million dollar seed in June 2025 from Peak XV and YC, absorbed the Auth.js project in September 2025 and was acquired by Vercel in July 2026, about a year after the seed. Developer pull and a hot category led to a quick exit, with terms undisclosed.
notes: Directory status says Active but sources show acquisition by Vercel announced 7 July 2026, so status is outdated. Acquisition terms undisclosed. Founding year not found in opened sources. Competitor list is empty because the comparison pages found were dated 2026, not near the batch. Core team joining Vercel is named in Vercel's post.
